about_the_game:
Break free from the everyday with daring activities and Getaways in The Sims™ 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack*. Nurture the spirit of play in childhood, and carry it through a bold, adventurous life. Create Custom Venues for Sims to explore and send them on Getaways, like a kids’ camp where Kids will find their playtime more meaningful than ever. They can even connect with Imaginary Friends!

Warm & Cozy Digital Content — Pair big adventures with big relaxation! Stay cozy outside with the Toasty Tower Lamp, enjoy a comforting beverage from the Toast-Tea Kettle, and keep your feet nice and snuggly with the Toasty Tootsies Socks — available when you order through November 13th, 2025**.
